panels.description: One lane per component. Hover a band to see its status. Short orange bands come from a single failed request, which the component retries, so look for bands that last or repeat.

panels.title: What a status means and what to do

options.content:
Start with `bin/sysmon status`, then the component's log in `logs/`.

| Status | Means | Do |
|---|---|---|
| Down | VictoriaMetrics cannot scrape it: it stopped, or sysmon-procs failed its last sample. | Restart its group: `bin/sysmon metrics stop`, then `bin/sysmon metrics`. For the Collector or ClickHouse, the same with `telemetry`. |
| Login expired | The usage API refused the Keychain login. | Open Claude Code, which renews it. |
| No login | The Keychain holds no Claude.ai login. | Sign in to Claude Code. |
| Read failed | claude-limits could not reach or understand the usage API. | Read `logs/claude-limits.log`. |
| Stalled | mactop's readings stopped changing, or claude-limits has not read for 15 minutes. | Restart the metrics group. |
| Rejecting inserts | A store refuses new data: VictoriaMetrics went read-only, or ClickHouse rejected an insert. | Free disk space, then read the store's log. |
| Dropping events | The Collector refused or lost Claude Code events. | Check ClickHouse, then `logs/otelcol.log`. |
| Throttled | The usage API answered 429, VictoriaMetrics refused work that waited too long for a slot, or ClickHouse delayed an insert. | Wait. claude-limits reads again in 5 minutes. |
| Backlog | Events wait in the Collector's queue for ClickHouse. | Check ClickHouse. |
| Low disk | Under 5% of the disk is free. | Free disk space before the store stops writing. |
| Too many parts | A ClickHouse partition holds over 300 parts. It slows inserts at 1000. | Check the merges below. |
| Errors | Requests failed in the last 5 minutes, or the usage API answered 5xx. | Read the component's log. |
| Slow | Work takes longer than usual. | Watch the latency charts below. |

panels.title: Collection: what VictoriaMetrics scrapes every 10 seconds
Targets answering
panels.description: Red is a scrape that failed. claude-limits answers 503 while its last read failed, so it goes red with a throttled or expired read. claude-limits-reads always answers while the service runs.

panels.title: Scrape time by target
panels.description: How long each target took to answer. A target near its 10-second timeout is about to fail its scrapes.

panels.title: Samples per scrape
panels.description: Series each target exposes, after the keep lists for ClickHouse and Grafana. sysmon-procs grows with the number of apps running.

panels.title: Failed and timed-out scrapes
panels.description: Scrapes that failed over the last 5 minutes, across all targets. Targets answering shows which one.

panels.title: Response size by target
panels.description: Bytes each scrape read.

panels.title: sysmon-procs sample time
panels.description: How long reading every process took. A sample that runs past the 10-second budget fails, and the scrape answers 503 until the next one succeeds.

panels.title: Apps and processes sampled
panels.description: What sysmon-procs sees. Its series and sample time grow with these.

panels.title: mactop readings per minute
panels.description: How often mactop's CPU reading changed. It drops to zero when mactop stops reading the machine while still answering scrapes, which is what Stalled means.

panels.title: claude-limits reads by outcome
panels.description: One read every 5 minutes. ok is a good read, http_429 is throttling, http_401 is an expired login, no_login is a missing login and failed is anything else.

panels.title: Time since a good read
panels.description: The plan limits on the Claude usage dashboard are this old. A sawtooth under the dashed line is healthy.

panels.title: Read time
panels.description: How long the last read of the usage API took.

panels.title: Samples stored
panels.description: Samples written per second. A drop means a target stopped answering.

panels.title: Active and new series
panels.description: New series come from processes starting, since each process is its own series. Steady churn is normal here.

panels.title: Stored data and free disk
panels.description: VictoriaMetrics goes read-only when free disk falls under its limit.

panels.title: Queries by path
panels.description: Requests per minute, mostly from Grafana.

panels.title: Query time, 99th percentile
panels.description: Over the last 5 minutes of each path. VictoriaMetrics logs any query over 5 seconds as slow.

panels.title: Concurrent requests against the limit
panels.description: Work beyond the limit waits, which shows as Throttled.

panels.title: CPU against its 2-core limit
panels.description: Cores busy. GOMAXPROCS caps VictoriaMetrics at 2 cores, so heavy queries queue behind each other near the line.

panels.title: Problems
panels.description: Over the last 5 minutes. A failed scrape logs a warning. A query with a typo counts as a refused request. Work waits when all 4 slots are busy, which opening a dashboard does, and a query times out after 10 seconds of waiting.

panels.title: Events in and out
panels.description: Events per minute. The lines should match within a batch of 10 seconds.

panels.title: Dropped and refused events
panels.description: Events lost over the last 5 minutes. Anything above zero is Claude Code telemetry that never reached ClickHouse.

panels.title: Queue against capacity
panels.description: Events wait here up to 10 seconds to form a batch. A queue that keeps growing means ClickHouse is not keeping up.

panels.title: Receive time
panels.description: How long Claude Code waits for the Collector to take a batch of events.

panels.title: Batch size
panels.description: Average batch written to ClickHouse. Bigger batches mean fewer inserts and fewer parts to merge.

panels.title: CPU and memory
panels.description: 100% is one core fully busy.

panels.title: Inserts and rows
panels.description: Per minute. Each Collector batch is one insert.

panels.title: Query time, average
panels.description: Inserts come from the Collector, selects from the Claude usage dashboard.

panels.title: Failed, delayed and rejected
panels.description: Over the last 5 minutes. ClickHouse delays inserts when a partition has too many parts and rejects them past 3000.

panels.title: Parts and merges
panels.description: Every insert writes a part, and merges fold them together. Parts that climb faster than merges fold them lead to delayed inserts at 1000 in a partition.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory ClickHouse accounts for across queries, merges and caches.

panels.title: Events stored

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() AS events FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Claude Code events in ClickHouse by the time they happened, read from the table itself.

panels.title: Newest event stored

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('second', max(Timestamp), now()) AS age FROM otel.otel_logs

panels.description: How long ago the newest Claude Code event happened. It grows while Claude Code is idle, and while events stop reaching ClickHouse.

panels.title: Errors in the time range, by code
panels.description: Every error ClickHouse raised, by its name, including failed queries typed by hand and errors ClickHouse recovered from on its own. A query that bounds the time with toDateTime on both sides raises TYPE_MISMATCH and still succeeds, so read Failed, delayed and rejected for queries that failed.

panels.description: Panels load through /api/ds/query, so that line is what a dashboard feels like.

panels.description: prometheus is VictoriaMetrics. An error that ClickHouse or VictoriaMetrics caused is marked downstream in Grafana's own metrics.
